faqs.q: Sec. 78-262. - Subject matter of the code.
faqs.a:
The subject matter of the Engineering Code of Standards and Specifications is comprised
               of 11 parts as follows:
(1)
Section 100 - Title, Scope, Control, and General Conditions.
(2)
Section 200 - Acceptance procedures.
(3)
Section 300 - Soils and Earthwork.
(4)
Section 400 - Water Supply Facilities.
(5)
Section 500 - Sanitary Sewer Facilities.
(6)
Section 600 - Storm Drainage Facilities.
(7)
Section 700 - Roadway and Parking Lot Design, Traffic Control Devices and Street Lighting.
(8)
Section 800 - Concrete Mix Design and Construction.
(9)
Section 900 - Asphalt Mix Design and Construction.
(10)
Section 1000 - Vegetation, Parks, and Recreation Facilities Construction.
(11)
Section 1100 - Control, measurement and basis of payment.
(Code 1981, § 27-191; Ord. No. 2391, § 1, 1-19-1987; Ord. No. 2429, § 1, 7-20-1987;
Ord. No. 4809
, § 1, 7-18-2022)
